nodes.name: analyze.md
nodes.summary: Windsurf AI workflow definition for analysing an existing codebase or feature — instructs the IDE agent to read artifacts, build a semantic model, and produce findings.

nodes.name: clarify.md
nodes.summary: Windsurf workflow for the requirements clarification phase, guiding the AI agent to ask targeted disambiguation questions before committing to a specification.

nodes.name: constitution.md
nodes.summary: Windsurf workflow that enforces architectural and design principles (the project constitution) as a gate before planning or implementation phases proceed.

nodes.name: implement.md
nodes.summary: Windsurf workflow for the implementation phase, directing the AI agent to execute tasks from tasks.md while respecting the plan and constitution constraints.

nodes.name: plan.md
nodes.summary: Windsurf workflow for generating an implementation plan from a feature specification, populating the plan.md artifact with phased technical design.

nodes.name: specify.md
nodes.summary: Minimal Windsurf workflow entry point that bootstraps the speckit specification process for a new feature, invoking the speckit.specify workflow.

nodes.name: speckit.analyze.md
nodes.summary: Full speckit workflow for deep specification analysis — loads feature artifacts, runs six detection passes (duplication, ambiguity, underspecification, constitution alignment, coverage gaps, inconsistency), and produces a severity-ranked report.

nodes.name: speckit.checklist.md
nodes.summary: Speckit workflow for generating targeted verification checklists (described as 'unit tests for English') from feature specifications, with examples and anti-patterns for common checklist types.

nodes.name: speckit.clarify.md
nodes.summary: Speckit requirements clarification workflow that interrogates user input to surface ambiguities, missing constraints, and hidden assumptions before writing a specification.

nodes.name: speckit.constitution.md
nodes.summary: Speckit constitution workflow for capturing and enforcing project-wide architectural rules, coding conventions, and non-negotiable constraints that all features must comply with.

nodes.name: speckit.implement.md
nodes.summary: Speckit implementation workflow directing the AI agent to execute individual tasks from tasks.md in priority order, with constitution and plan validation at each step.

nodes.name: speckit.plan.md
nodes.summary: Speckit planning workflow that transforms a feature specification into a two-phase implementation plan (outline/research then design/contracts), with rules for maintaining traceability to the spec.

nodes.name: speckit.specify.md
nodes.summary: Speckit specification authoring workflow with detailed guidelines for writing user stories, acceptance criteria, functional requirements, and success metrics using the spec-template format.

nodes.name: speckit.tasks.md
nodes.summary: Speckit task generation workflow that decomposes a plan into a structured, checkbox-formatted task list with phased organisation, dependency tracking, and parallel execution opportunities.

nodes.name: tasks.md
nodes.summary: Windsurf workflow entry point for task generation, delegating to speckit.tasks to produce a phased implementation task list from the current feature's plan and spec.
